required_before_authorization: Successful H conversion and full v3 state verification
Two pinned-image H opens at 16 GiB with matching head/root, sampled BAL bodies, and clean stops
Exact qualification report SHA-256 bound to the upload job
required_before_release: Stopped-source streaming with conversion and qualification locks held
Publish source genesis, image/commit, conversion/reopen proof, archive bytes and checksum
retention_scope: Original release had full BAL-body validation. Post-conversion worker qualification currently checks three bodies; do not describe that as a new full-range audit.
recovery_volume_gate: Measure converted archive size before replacing or downloading onto a 550 GiB recovery volume; retain the verified original archive meanwhile.

controller_review.live_check: refused: H conversion-complete.json and qualification/result.json do not exist; conversion and queued qualification units still active

converter_provenance_policy: For a patched converter, qualification and conversion records must contain the same converter_build. Release metadata and the conversion proof retain its base commit, patch SHA-256 and binary SHA-256 separately from the unmodified worker image.

automatic_handoff.credentials_scope: Account credentials remain in the private controller environment; only object-scoped multipart URLs go to the VM

tail_batch_resume.reason: Controller deliberately stopped and recreated around native tail batch handoff; no upload authorization issued

upload_cpu_observation.decision: Keep existing 400% CPU quota: sampled usage was 1.44 cores with zero throttling; no live configuration change or restart

remaining_publication_gates: Publish metadata and exact archive size
Review recovery-volume capacity against final compressed size
